# Clean Rows

> Clean Rows builds custom B2B prospect lists for business customers. Each list is researched to an agreed brief (ideal customer profile), checked before delivery and delivered as a CSV file or Google Sheet. Pricing is per list with no seat fees and no subscription, and new customers can review 100 free leads before their first paid order.

Key facts:
- Standard packages (USD): $25 for 1,000 leads, $199 for 10,000, $799 for 50,000. Orders of 100,000+ leads and specialist research are quoted.
- Free sample: up to 100 leads for your ICP, one per business, delivered within 24 hours of the request once the ICP is reviewed.
- Sources: publicly accessible business sources (public professional profiles such as LinkedIn, company websites, public directories and registries, public regulatory filings). Business emails are checked with two independent verification services; duplicates are removed.
- Not offered: tech-stack enrichment, intent data, a searchable database, native CRM sync, consumer data.
- Customers: businesses only, mainly agencies, B2B software and B2B service firms in the US, UK, EU, Canada and Australia.
- Contact: hello@cleanrows.com

## Service

- [Pricing](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/pricing): Standard packages, what is included and how ordering works.
- [Free sample](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/free-sample): Request 100 free leads and how to review them.
- [What's in the file](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/whats-in-the-file): The 10 standard field groups and a CSV preview.
- [Custom lists](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/services/custom-lists): Briefs, feasibility, exclusions and custom quotes.
- [Data sources](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/data-sources): Where the data comes from and what "verified" means.

## Who it is for

- [Agencies](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/for/agencies): One brief and file per client campaign.
- [B2B SaaS](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/for/saas): Market tests, territories and target accounts.
- [Recruitment agencies](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/for/recruitment): Employer business-development lists, not candidate data.

## Target lists

- [CEO and founder lists](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/lists/ceos): Title rules and company criteria.
- [VP of Sales lists](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/lists/vp-sales): Sales-leadership title map.
- [Fintech lists](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/lists/fintech): Subsector definitions before contacts.

## Comparisons

- [Clean Rows vs Apollo](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/compare/apollo): List service versus per-seat sales platform (sources dated).
- [Clean Rows vs ZoomInfo](https://clean-rows-astro.vercel.app/compare/zoominfo): One-time list versus quote-based subscription (sources dated).
